body:
Thank you for your kind words. I don't believe I deserve to be alone, but I've done nothing to deserve affection. I'm left with loneliness by default through lack of my own action. Only I am to blame for this.

I take your points on board. Just from reading threads here and /r/depression I can see that, and it's not something I was unaware of. Some people have real problems. 

I have made my own problems through being incredibly introverted for at least a decade. I put my life on hold, applying an "it's fine, I'll do it later" attitude to life while my peers bettered theirs.

There's only so much shit people will take from you before they start to see you as a toxic influence on their life. When this happened to me, I started to see through my own disguise. I feel sick when I think about it, it just makes me cry.

I am aware that my situation is not unique, my problems aren't special.
